description: Source class 'Vtiger_Link' providing API to manage custom links within the vtiger CRM system, including functions for initializing, adding, deleting, and retrieving links related to modules.

classes.name: Vtiger_Link
classes.description: Class managing custom link operations within vtiger CRM, including link initialization, addition, removal, and retrieval, with schema caching and handler support.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets object properties based on provided value map.

methods.name: module
methods.description: Returns the module name associated with the link's tab ID.

methods.name: __getUniqueId
methods.description: Generates and returns a unique ID for link records.

methods.name: __initSchema
methods.description: Initializes database schema for 'vtiger_links' table if not already created.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Adds a new link entry to the database for a specified module.

methods.name: deleteLink
methods.description: Removes specific link entries from the database based on parameters.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all links associated with a specified module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all links for a given module.

methods.name: getAllByType
methods.description: Retrieves links filtered by module and type(s), with support for parameterized URL merging.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs message details, typically for debugging or audit.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has admin privileges.
